Episode Notes:
Mike talks with Justin Bronk of RUSI about the evolving nature of airpower in the Russo-Ukrainian War. They discuss both sides’ long-range strike campaigns and the range of aircraft involved, then dig into the capabilities and limitations on each side and the challenges that Ukraine faces in effectively employing its air assets. They close with a discussion of air defense, including cautionary notes on extrapolating lessons from this war to other conflicts.
